prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: synthetic ClassTrace demo evidence photo, square work-sample thumbnail
Primary request: a realistic top-down smartphone photo of an anonymous middle-school paragraph draft in pencil, showing a clear opening topic sentence, three supporting detail lines, and a small teacher question mark beside the final detail where explanation is still thin
Scene/backdrop: subdued gray-green classroom tabletop with the edge of a wooden pencil
Subject: one lined writing page with natural erasures, uneven handwriting, and a modest revision
Style/medium: natural documentary photography with believable paper grain and pencil pressure, not an illustration
Composition/framing: square close crop with slight rotation and ordinary phone-camera perspective
Lighting/mood: even classroom light, focused and truthful
Constraints: synthetic work sample only; no people, faces, hands, names, initials, school names, class names, logos, dates, identifying information, watermarks, or UI; prose should not be prominently legible
Avoid: calligraphy, polished adult handwriting, colorful decoration, stock-photo perfection
